key.name: lock-delay
key.description: Seconds to wait after the radar reports nobody there before locking. The radar itself already waits about 10 seconds.

key.name: lock-when-inhibited
key.summary: Lock even when the screensaver is blocked
key.description: Lock even when an app is blocking the screensaver, for example during video playback or a presentation.

key.name: auto-lock
key.description: Lock the screen when you walk away. Can be unchecked in the Quick Settings menu to pause auto-locking.

key.name: stay-awake
key.description: While the radar sees you, keep the screen from dimming, blanking, locking or suspending on its own.

key.name: radar
key.description: Switch the radar on. Turned off with the Quick Settings tile, which stops auto-locking and staying awake, and saves the radar's power.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show an icon in the top bar with the current presence status. Errors are shown even when this is off.
